rationale: All three lenses ran on the full 202-line diff. The acceptance lens audited the ticket and the plan and returned 14 pass / 0 fail / 0 partial, confirming the fix lands on the real reproduction path (Data Sources -> type File -> IndexTypeFile.tsx -> FilesDropzone). No blocking findings survived triage: 2 findings were bucketed defer (the same-name in-place swap and the paired-message queue pressure, both unreachable through the current UI, where adds always append and removals always delete) and 4 dismissed (style, message grammar and an untested display boundary with no defect behind it). One lens claim was refuted against the source: namesOnlyIn is a multiset diff over a count Map, so removing one of two identically named files is announced correctly. Standards: commit subjects match the git-workflow guide; no code-quality guide exists in this repo; the security guide has no surface here (the builder only concatenates strings into a React text node).
